steps.say: Click any blue dot to place a disc: a line of the other colour must sit between your new disc and one of yours, and those discs flip.
Some moves flip more than others. Find the move that flips the most discs.
steps.tip: Count how many discs each dot would flip.

steps.say: Corners can never be flipped back. When you can take a corner, it is usually the best move.
steps.tip: One of the dots is in a corner.
